rubric: accurate quotations with references and translation; labeled paraphrases

cases.body: I keep spending my evenings making lists instead of doing the one thing I care about. How do I get unstuck?
I am new to the Bible. Why does the Good Samaritan story make the outsider the example?
I am not Christian, but Jesus saying to love your enemies interests me. Does that mean accepting mistreatment?
I slept late and now feel behind. Can you help me think about the rest of my day through scripture?
Why do Christians read faith and works differently in James 2? Please distinguish the passage from your interpretation.
A friend says that because two events happened together, one must have caused the other. What is missing from that argument?
